method: SLUB Dresden OAI-PMH set maps in METS: per-object MODS/DFG-viewer Public Domain Mark gate, original JPEG/PDF bitstreams and a resumable shard.

selection.rule: Every record in the documented SLUB OAI-PMH set maps is a candidate. It is admitted only when the item’s own METS states the Public Domain Mark 1.0 (MODS use-and-reproduction href/text, or dv:license=pdm with slubarchiv:copyrightStatus=publicdomain) and carries no separate restrictive statement. The first ORIGINAL bitstream and PDF become original-access links; no IIIF service, extent, place or alignment is invented, and no thumbnail is shipped while SLUB’s Anubis check blocks browser subresource loads.

policy.statement: SLUB’s digital-collections terms state that digitised objects whose copyright has expired are made available under the Public Domain Mark 1.0 and require the source citation (SLUB Dresden, PURL/URN, licence). Per-object statements are retained on every entry. SLUB does not publish a separate metadata licence; metadata is reused with attribution and a link to each original record.

verification.browserNote: A Chrome user-agent request receives SLUB’s Anubis bot check, not image bytes, so the direct bitstream URLs are not used as previews. The count above is a server-side availability check with the harvest user-agent; browser access to the record page is the supported route.
